content:
mike: FYI kicking off the Edge Accelerator preview with our hardware partner — want to align on NDA cadence, benchmark plan, and telemetry hooks. Who can own the first draft of the bench matrix?
sofia: I can take the bench matrix draft. will start from last cycle's template and strip anything partner-sensitive.
akshay: thanks — can you include token-length buckets + perf p95/p50 and memory footprint per batch size? that's what infra wants.
elena: Also need a simple list of required kernel builds and the quantization profiles we want tested (int8/int4). I'll add that to the matrix.
mike: perfect. Sofia, aim to share v0 by EOD Tue. We'll use that for the NDA appendix.
sofia: EOD Tue works. Quick Q: do we have approved language for telemetry in the NDA? partner asked about perf/ops logs.
ranjit: We have a telemetry clause in company boilerplate but partner requested sample telemetry schema. I'll pull the minimal fields we can share (no PII).
mike: good — keep it minimal: job_id, model_variant, token_count, latency_ms_p50/p95, gpu_util, memory_mb, env_tag. nothing else.
akshay: for benchmarks we should run: 1) online gen (low latency), 2) batched throughput, 3) cold-start KV cache. can include a micro-benchmark for attention kernel.
elena: can we add a quick script snippet customers can run? e.g.:
```
python run_bench.py --model redwood-edge-v1 --batch 1 --seq 512 --profile perf.json
```
that helps partners reproduce.
sofia: nice. I'll add that. Also adding a short how-to for collecting `nvidia-smi` + our telemetry shim.
mike: on rollout: timeline suggestion — share bench matrix + NDA appendix Tue, partner runs tests Wed-Thu, sync Thurs EOD for results, iterate Fri. Thoughts?
ranjit: timeline is tight but doable. we should give them a fallback window next week in case lab access delays.
akshay: agree. also request they run both single-process and multi-process worker configs to capture scheduling effects.
elena: can we request kernel logs via our shim? if partners can't expose kernel symbols, ask for aggregate metrics only.
mike: yes — aggregate only. note that any kernel builds we provide should be under our EAP license terms — include a short checklist in the repo.
sofia: I'll create a private repo and add the bench harness + docs; will invite the partner. tagging infra perms: @akshay @ranjit please confirm CI credentials we'll give them.
akshay: will set up ephemeral creds with scoped S3 read/write + bench queue access. I'll document TTL and rotation policy.
ranjit: I'll coordinate SSH/lab access windows and add a calendar invite for the Thurs sync.
mike: perfect. one more: marketplace listing coordination — partner wants to plan a joint blog. let's avoid marketing details in the NDA thread; but we should note the PR plan: embargo until both parties sign off. add a short line in the summary doc.
sofia: adding embargo & joint-announcement checkbox. also adding contact points for legal.
elena: last item: regression hooks — can we set up a lightweight perf regression alert that triggers if p95 latency increases 20% vs baseline? Could be useful for post-preview monitoring.
akshay: yes, we can add a perf-alert rule in Redwood Console for the partner's tenant during the EAP window. I'll preconfigure.
mike: awesome. Action items:
- sofia: bench matrix + repo + NDA appendix (due Tue EOD)
- akshay: ephemeral creds + Console perf alert (due Wed)
- ranjit: lab access windows + Thurs sync invite (due Tue)
- elena: kernel/quant profiles + run script examples (due Tue)
- mike: draft partner-facing summary & embargo note (due Tue)
Please post links here when ready. :thumbsup:
buildbot: Deploy bot: created private repo `redwood/edge-accel-preview` and invited sofia, elena, akshay, ranjit. Repo URL: https://git.internal/redwood/edge-accel-preview
sofia: got it, thanks buildbot. will push v0 by EOD Tue and ping here.
mike: thanks everyone — we'll keep this thread as the single source for preview logistics.
